compiled_state.title: Implement applier that dispatches mutations and writes per-pass flat-JSON manifest
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: RED task. Implement apply(mutations, pass_id) -> Path in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py. Dispatches each mutation to matching AcliClient method (create/update/delete). Writes flat JSON manifest to bridge_state/snapshots/<pass_id>.manifest.json with shape {pass_id, mutation_count, mutations}. Manifest written even when mutation_count=0 (required for DD-3). Unit tests assert manifest written at expected path, correct shape, empty-mutations case, correct AcliClient method routing.
